payload.body: ISSUE:0004 is validated at 45edf8f, so on vc's side it has landed. A fresh clone is green: check all, test all (36 bats tests, none failing), build, doctor (0 failed, the shadowing note only) and release check. bin/devbin release 0.1.6 --dry-run passes with gh reads only (auth status, release view), and the 0.1.5 dry run is refused. No Python, tools/, xtask, .cargo, workspace or keychain-upgrade file is left, actionlint is in check all, and the tree is clean after the runs. Real data: the v0.1.5 release verifies, and all 12 faulted copies are refused at the check meant for each. formula render v0.1.5 gives the tap's exact arm and Intel sha256, and a CI-only draft is refused. Mutation pass: 47 mutations over macos, nopython, the formula template and build.yml, 42 red. Each of the 5 survivors has a second guard, and each pair goes red when both are removed: the two member counts and the two mac-ext reads. A missing manifest entry is also refused by the sha256 and requirement checks. Left for the close: the real 0.1.6 cut end to end, and hv's push of the tap's 1e74059 before formula publish. ISSUE:0003 is next. FYI: your board's focus line still names the Rust xtask.
